title: Something Dies on Friday

scenes.notify: Cheese goes off tomorrow! Toasties tonight? 🧀

caption: The scariest thing in your fridge? The cheese you forgot 👻 Fridgeroo counts down the days and warns you the night before: fridgeroo.netlify.app
why: Strongest unused feature, reads in 1 s; Tue→Fri = exactly the 3-2-1 countdown. Halloween hook with 👻 (playful, not violent). Punch cut (double ending). New sequence hook,countdown,end.
